text:
maria: Kicking off provisioning for 'orchid-apac-se' private cluster (customer site). goal: air-gapped VPC bring-up + GPU pool. I'm going onsite tomorrow to hand off seed images and network configs. TL;DR checklist below.

lee: Nice. Can you paste the VLAN IDs and expected MTU? customer router is managed by NetCorp.

maria: VLANs: 110 (mgmt), 120 (control), 130 (pods), 140 (storage). MTU should be 9000 end-to-end. NetCorp requires BGP ASNs — customer AS 64512, our upstream AS 64501.

sam: Also confirm public egress path for telemetry? We need to allow collector IPs to reach telemetry.redwood.com over 443, unless customer will proxy.

devon: On the airgap side: bring a USB with these artifacts:
- seed-images.tar.gz (sha256: ab12...)
- registry-mirror.tar (contains curated model containers)
- offline-k8s-manifests.tar

akiko: For GPU nodes: customer requested A10G x4 to start (cost vs perf tradeoff discussed). Provisioning note: driver install must match kernel 6.1. Use our packaged installer: `installer_gpu_v2.sh --driver 535.XX --cuda 12.2`.

maria: Exact commands I'll run on-site:

```bash
# unpack seed images
sha256sum seed-images.tar.gz
tar xzf seed-images.tar.gz
sudo rsync -av ./images/ /var/lib/registry/images/
# load to local registry (airgap)
containerd load -i registry-mirror.tar
kubectl apply -f offline-k8s-manifests/
```

lee: Reminder: change `/etc/hosts` for registry.local -> 10.0.120.5 before kubelets start so init containers can pull.

sam: Security checklist: bring encrypted HSM token for KMS key wrapping, and customer SOC contact for RDP/console access. Also ensure root CA bundle includes customer CA.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Seed images checksum validated (seed-images.tar.gz: OK).

devon: On validation, run these probes after cluster is up:
- `kubectl get nodes` (expect all nodes Ready)
- `kubectl describe nodes | grep -i gpu` check device plugin
- run tiny inference smoke test against local model endpoint (latency < 300ms for 64 tokens)

akiko: Watch for OOMs during driver install on older BIOS — set `iommu=pt` kernel var if we see stalls.

maria: Handoff notes for Customer Success and Oncall:
- Handoff doc: /runbooks/orchid-apac-se-handoff (I'll upload after site)
- Contact: netops@customer (primary), seops@redwood (oncall)
- Escalation: if node fails to register after 10m, enable debug logs and escalate to eng-infra.

lee: Cost note: starting with 4x A10G is ~monthly $Xk in committed capacity; suggest tag nodes with `env:customer-orchid` to track usage.

sam: One last offline tweak: prune models in registry >30d to save disk. We'll include a cronjob in manifests.

maria: Thanks all — I'll post final go/no-go 1hr before flight. :airplane:

akiko: Good luck! ping me if you need remote assist during driver steps. :+1:
